# golambda_zip_archive (Resource)

Builds a Go main package from a remote module or a local directory into a reproducible AWS Lambda zip archive. The build runs during plan, so build failures fail the plan and the archive hash is known before apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "commit_sha" {
  type = string
}

resource "golambda_zip_archive" "handler" {
  target = "github.com/acme/lambdas/cmd/handler@${var.commit_sha}"
  goarch = "arm64"
}

# A binary that doubles as a CLI tool, invoked with arguments.
resource "golambda_zip_archive" "worker" {
  target = "github.com/acme/tools/cmd/acme@${var.commit_sha}"
  args   = ["worker", "--queue=jobs"]
}

# A package in the same repository as this configuration. It's rebuilt on
# every plan and only changes when the archive bytes do.
resource "golambda_zip_archive" "local" {
  source_dir = "${path.module}/../cmd/handler"
}

resource "aws_lambda_function" "handler" {
  function_name    = "handler"
  role             = aws_iam_role.lambda.arn
  runtime          = "provided.al2023"
  handler          = "bootstrap"
  architectures    = ["arm64"]
  filename         = golambda_zip_archive.handler.output_path
  source_code_hash = golambda_zip_archive.handler.output_base64sha256
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `args` (List of String) Arguments to run the binary with. When set, `bootstrap` is a shell script that execs the binary (stored under its own name) with these arguments.
- `build_tags` (List of String) Build tags. Defaults to `["lambda.norpc"]`.
- `go_version` (String) Go toolchain version, like `1.27.4`. Defaults to `1.27.4`; the default may change in new provider releases.
- `goarch` (String) Target `GOARCH`. Defaults to `arm64`.
- `goos` (String) Target `GOOS`. Defaults to `linux`.
- `ldflags` (String) Extra linker flags, appended to `-s -w -buildid=`.
- `output_path` (String) Where to write the archive. Defaults to a path under the provider's `cache_dir` named after the archive's SHA-256, so it only changes when the contents do.
- `source_dir` (String) Local directory of the main package to build, such as `"${path.module}/../cmd/handler"`. It must be inside a Go module whose `go.mod` and `go.sum` are complete. Relative paths are relative to the working directory. Because there's no version to compare, the package is rebuilt on every plan, and the resource only changes when the archive bytes do.
- `target` (String) Package to build, as `<package>@<version>`, like `go install`. The version must be a commit hash or an exact semantic version. Exactly one of `target` and `source_dir` is required.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The archive's SHA-256 (hex).
- `output_base64sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the archive, base64 encoded. Use this for `aws_lambda_function.source_code_hash`.
- `output_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the archive, hex encoded.
- `output_size` (Number) Size of the archive in bytes.
- `resolved_version` (String) The canonical module version the target's version resolved to, such as a pseudo-version for a commit hash. Null for `source_dir` builds.
